llm.confirmDeleteActiveWithFallback: You are deleting the active provider. After deletion, the app will switch to "{{name}}". Continue?
llm.confirmDeleteActiveWithoutFallback: You are deleting the only active provider. After deletion, no active provider will remain and AI features will stop working. Continue?
llm.activeProviderDeletedFallback: The active provider was deleted. Switched to "{{name}}".
llm.activeProviderDeletedEmpty: The active provider was deleted. No active provider is configured now.
llm.testMissingFields: Fill in the base URL, API key, and model first
llm.presetCustomDesc: Manually enter the API base URL and model

general.title: General Settings
general.languageDesc: Change the display language of the application
general.defaultDownloadPathDesc: Download tasks will save here by default. If unset, the workspace folder is used.
general.defaultDownloadPathUnset: Not set. The workspace folder will be used.
general.cliPathDesc: Set the local faster-whisper CLI executable path. This path is used when the CLI transcription engine is selected.
general.cliInstallSuccess: Faster-Whisper CLI installed and path filled
general.autoExecuteDesc: Automatically trigger subsequent steps after a task completes (Download → Transcribe → Translate → Synthesize).
general.autoTrimSilenceDesc: For full-video exports, use Whisper subtitle timings to remove content before the first speech segment and after the last, including music or ambient sound. Videos without subtitles are unchanged. Disabled by default and does not affect clip exports.
general.smartSplitTextLimitDesc: Subtitles longer than this always enter smart split. Shorter lines can still split when a strong boundary is detected. CJK uses character count; other languages are converted with the current rule.
general.smartSplitTextLimitInvalid: Enter an integer greater than or equal to 1
general.cudaDesc: Checks whether built-in faster-whisper can use the NVIDIA GPU on this machine.
general.cudaSummaryReady: CUDA is ready for GPU transcription with built-in faster-whisper.
general.cudaSummaryNotReady: CUDA is not ready. Resolve the missing items below, then check again.

cudaDependencyDetails.ready: {{name}} is available to the current backend process.
cudaDependencyDetails.notOnPath: {{name}} is installed but is not on the current backend process PATH.
cudaDependencyDetails.unknown: The status of {{name}} could not be determined.

general.cudaGuidanceReady: Select GPU (CUDA/Float16) when transcribing to use the GPU.
general.cudaGuidanceDriver: Install or update the NVIDIA driver and confirm that nvidia-smi runs successfully.
general.cudaGuidanceRuntime: Install matching CUDA 12, cuBLAS 12, and cuDNN 9 runtime libraries, then add their bin folders to the backend process PATH.
general.ytDlpDesc: Update the bundled yt-dlp downloader. Restart the backend if the new version is not applied immediately.
